full_details.title: US based Senior Software Developer
full_details.full_description:
Summary
We are looking for a talented US-native Full Stack Developer to join our growing team focused on AI, automation, and modern software solutions.

You will work with innovative projects involving AI systems, Python development, workflow automation, APIs, and scalable web applications for international clients.

Tech Stack:

Python
AI/LLM integrations
Automation systems
React / Next.js
Node.js
APIs & cloud platforms

Requirements:

Must be a US-native or US-based developer with excellent English communication skills
Strong full stack development experience
Experience with AI or automation projects
Good understanding of scalable system architecture
Professional communication with clients and team members
Comfortable joining client meetings and discussions
Self-managed and reliable work style

What We Offer:

Long-term collaboration
Fully remote work
High-value international projects
Flexible working environment
Strong internal engineering team
Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI products

We are looking for developers who are passionate about building modern AI-powered applications and want to grow with a fast-moving team.
full_details.author: tyler

ai_proposal.opis:
Hey Tyler,

Straight to it: we're not US-based. We're a two-person dev team working out of Poland. I know that's likely a hard filter for you, so no hard feelings if you stop reading here. But if what you actually need is someone who can sit on your client calls, understand an AI workflow, and then ship it end to end, that part we've got covered. We work US hours, everything we write is in English, and we're on every meeting, not behind a PM.

Here's what I read between the lines of your post. You're not really hiring a "US developer". You're hiring someone who can hold a conversation with your client about their automation problem, then turn it into working Python services, an LLM layer that doesn't hallucinate, and a React front end that doesn't fall over when traffic spikes. Most people who pass the native English bar hand the build off to someone else. We do both halves, and we've done it for international clients before.

Concretely on the stack you listed: Python is our daily driver for AI and automation. We've built RAG pipelines (a search-and-answer layer on top of a company's own documents), OCR plus LLM for pulling structured data out of invoices and PDFs, and n8n / Make workflows that push results straight into CRMs. On the front we're comfortable in React and Next.js talking to Python or Node back ends. Cloud APIs, webhooks, integrations, all bread and butter.

What we don't do: hourly tracking, micromanaging, or pretending a retainer is a disguised daily rate. We agree on the outcome, we own delivery, you get a weekly written status and a working build. This is a monthly retainer at 5800 zł per month, ongoing, covering your active projects, calls, code review and shipping.

If the location thing is a dealbreaker, fair enough. If it's not and you want to pressure-test us, 15 minutes on a call and we'll walk through a recent AI project, architecture included. Happy to prep a short demo of a similar pipeline first if it helps you decide.

Pozdrawiam
